{{Top}}
[[File:StudyLokIII.jpg|250px|thumb|[[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok the third]], studying ancient Sith artifacts.]]
{{Quote|That's it! I'm submitting my resignation as a Sith artifact documentarian. How many images of evil carving knives and malevolent kitchen appliances do you need?|[[Marn Hierogryph]], documenting Sith artifacts in the [[Sanctum of the Exalted]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 29">[[Knights of the Old Republic 29|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 29]]</ref>}}
'''Sith Artifacts''', sometimes known as '''Sith treasures''', were priceless [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force artifact/Legends|items]], ancient in their creation but invaluable to [[darksider]]s for their potency and [[Sith sorcery/Legends|uni]][[Sith alchemy/Legends|que]] interaction with the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Sith artifacts included [[Sith spellbook/Legends|Sith spellbooks]], [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulets]] and talismans, [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]], [[Sith sword]]s, [[Sith scroll/Legends|Sith scrolls]] or tomes. Sith Artifacts were deemed highly dangerous. While some of them was known of their healing powers, Sith amulets and talismans were weapons of the dark side, channeling immense dark side power. They also granted the ability to learn Sith scrolls and spellbooks, containing dark knowledge of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and ideology, which were often plauged by their author's madness, driving their reader insane.<ref name=":0">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref><ref name=":1">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref><ref name=":0" />

==History==
{{Quote|They say you have found Sith treasures. What gift have you brought me?|King Ommin to Aleema and Satal Keto in 3998 BBY|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
Around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], after the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], most of the Sith Artifacts were destroyed or taken by the Jedi Knights in order to prevent the propagation of Sith ideology and their fall into wrong hands.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />

In the year [[3998 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]] sealed a trove of Sith artifacts within the [[Tomb of Freedon Nadd]], after [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|relocating the tomb]] from its former home under the [[Iziz Royal Palace|Royal Palace]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon's]] single great city. The tomb and its resident artifacts were then moved to a new location, on Onderon's fourth moon, [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]].

The [[Jedi Covenant]] gathered a number of artifacts and stored them in the [[Sanctum of the Exalted]], encased in a [[Nullification resin|special wrapping]] to keep their influence from escaping. However, instead of leaving them be, they did tests on the artifacts, causing severe weather patterns on [[Odryn]]. The Covenant's retainer, [[Haazen]], even used the Covenant to gather Sith artifacts so he could strengthen his powers.
